project_info.theme: Bottle-return reward poster featuring a Cocoon tote bag
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, White, Light Denim Blue, Soft Lime Green, Metallic Gray

main_subject.detail: A low-angle outdoor lifestyle image of a person leaning over a metal railing while holding a pale green tote bag printed 'Cocoon VIỆT NAM', with large white campaign text explaining bottle-return counts required to redeem one fabric bag.
main_subject.style: Casual eco-lifestyle photography, airy sky composition, clean awareness poster

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes '10 vỏ chai lớn (DUNG TÍCH LỚN HƠN 50ML)', '25 vỏ chai nhỏ (CÁC DUNG TÍCH CÒN LẠI)', and '1 túi vải'.
items: Top Left: Cropped upper body of the model in white t-shirt, leaning over silver and bronze railings against a clear blue sky.
Top Right: Large white numbers 10 and 25 with Vietnamese explanatory text and curved white arrows pointing toward a doodled tote icon.
Bottom Left: Full pale green fabric tote bag hanging from the person's hands, printed with oversized white 'Cocoon VIỆT NAM'.
Bottom Right: Huge white text '1 túi vải' and a hand-drawn green tote icon sticker on an off-white cutout shape.
Center/Background: Clean open-sky background with diagonal metal railings adding structure.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Airy clean shadows, optimistic outdoor feel, soft fabric texture visibility, fresh sustainability mood

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity lifestyle campaign photography with doodle overlay

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a bottle-return reward campaign featuring a Cocoon tote bag. Centerpiece is a person standing behind metal railings and holding a pale green tote printed 'Cocoon VIỆT NAM' against a wide blue sky. Background is minimal open air with strong diagonal railing lines. Surrounding elements: large white text '10 vỏ chai lớn', '25 vỏ chai nhỏ', '1 túi vải', curved white arrows, and a green hand-drawn tote icon sticker. Keep the low-angle lifestyle perspective, airy spacing, and exact campaign wording. Technical style: high fidelity lifestyle campaign photography with doodle overlay, bright natural daylight, airy clean shadows and fresh sustainability mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
